name: TTTstrat
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y coinor-libipopt-dev && python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' && .venv/bin/pip install ipykernel && .venv/bin/python -m ipykernel install --user --name TTTstrat --display-name 'Python (TTTstrat)'
